answer: Put a refundable bond behind every identity and let the people who check the work keep the bond when the work turns out hollow. Because the forfeit is priced against the disruption one wander could cause, a crowd of copies needs a treasury, not a script. Slashed collateral flows to the graders who caught the fraud, so policing a cipher becomes paid work instead of charity, and honest keys get their bond back like fruit returned from a cedar.
